mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.content, c.owner_comment, c.article_id, c.guest_name, c.parent_id, c.status, c.reviewed_at, c.created_at FROM comments c WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.status = 'approved' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND status = 'approved'

SELECT c.id, c.content, c.owner_comment, c.article_id, c.guest_name, c.parent_id, c.status, c.reviewed_at, c.created_at, a.title AS article_title FROM comments c JOIN articles a ON c.article_id = a.id WHERE c.status = #{status} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE status = #{status}
